  appendSubset (cih Hc) (appendSubset (tih Ht) (eih He))
 has type
  (extractOldExprVars c✝ ++ (extractOldExprVars t✝ ++ extractOldExprVars e✝)).Subset
    (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars c✝ ++ (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars t✝ ++ Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e✝))
but is expected to have type
  (extractOldExprVars c✝ ++ extractOldExprVars t✝ ++ extractOldExprVars e✝).Subset
    (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars c✝ ++ Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars t✝ ++ Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e✝)
